params.name: states
params.description: Filter results by one or more parcel states. See [parcel states](https://developers.cabify.com/reference/logistics-introduction#parcel) for a description of each value.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of parcels that match the specified states.

Create one or more parcels to be shipped. Note that creating a parcel does not trigger a delivery — you must call `/v1/parcels/ship` afterwards to schedule the pickup.

Each parcel requires a pickup and a drop-off location. You can provide a location using one of the following fields in the `pickup_info` or `dropoff_info` schemas: `loc` (coordinates), `addr` (address string), or `hub_external_id` (reference to a registered hub).

info.name: Get proof of delivery configuration for a parcel.

params.name: parcel_id
params.description: UUID of the parcel whose proof of delivery configuration you want to retrieve.

items.docs: Returns the proof of delivery methods currently configured for the specified parcel.

info.name: Set proof of delivery configuration for a parcel.

params.name: parcel_id
params.description: UUID of the parcel to configure proof of delivery for.

items.docs: Creates or replaces the proof of delivery methods configured for the specified parcel.

Permanently deletes the specified parcels. Only parcels that have not yet been shipped can be deleted. This is an **all-or-nothing** operation — if any parcel cannot be deleted, none of the parcels in the request will be deleted.

params.name: parcel_id
params.description: UUID of the parcel to retrieve.

items.docs: Returns the full details of a parcel identified by its UUID.

params.name: parcel_id
params.description: UUID of the parcel to update.

items.docs:
Update editable fields of an existing parcel. The set of fields that can be modified depends on the parcel's current state:

**All fields** can be updated when the parcel is in one of these states: `ready`, `pickupfailed`, `requestercancel`, or `returnedtoorigin`.

**Instructions only** (`pickup_info.instr`, `dropoff_info.instr`) can be updated in all other active states.

info.name: Get the tip for a parcel.

params.name: parcel_id
params.description: UUID of the parcel whose tip you want to retrieve.

items.docs:
> **Note:** This feature is not available to all clients. Please contact us before using it.

Returns the tip configured for the specified parcel, if one exists.

info.name: Add a tip for a parcel delivery.

params.name: parcel_id
params.description: UUID of the parcel to tip.

items.docs:
> **Note:** This feature is not available to all clients. Please contact us before using it.

Adds a tip for the driver in the event of a successful delivery. The tip can be set at any
point before the parcel is delivered. The tip amount must be formatted according to ISO 4217
(e.g. €6.30 → `630` in EUR).

info.name: Get the shipping label for a parcel.

items.docs: Returns the shipping label for the specified parcel as a PDF. This label is scanned by the driver during pickup and delivery operations.

info.name: Notify an event for the given parcel.

params.name: parcel_id
params.description: UUID of the parcel to notify an event for.

items.docs:
Sends an event notification for the specified parcel. Currently, only the `ready_to_pickup`
event is supported.

This event is typically used in food delivery workflows to signal that an order is prepared
and ready to be collected by a driver.
